system.name: Student Support Ecosystem
system.description: An intelligent student support system using multiple specialized AI agents to profile students, deliver personalized interventions, and continuously monitor and adjust support plans across academic, social, and psychological dimensions.
system.architecture: Multi-Lane BPMN with 8 Swim Lanes representing agents/interfaces

tasks.name: Registration
tasks.description: Student initiates entry into the system by registering.

tasks.name: Complete Registration
tasks.description: Student completes their full registration form — name, ID, program, contact details.

tasks.name: View Resources / Attend
tasks.description: Student views assigned resources or attends recommended sessions/interventions.

tasks.name: Cycle Complete
tasks.description: Marks the end of one support cycle. Either loops back for continuation or terminates.

tasks.name: End
tasks.description: Process terminates — student has completed all support cycles.

swim_lanes.name: STUDENT_PROFILING_AGENT
swim_lanes.role: Collects and synthesizes student profile data

tasks.name: Collect Demographics
tasks.description: Agent collects demographic data: age, program, year level, background, prior academic history.

tasks.name: Administer Surveys
tasks.description: Agent administers standardized surveys to assess student needs, learning styles, challenges, and preferences.

tasks.name: Generate Profile
tasks.description: Agent synthesizes demographics + survey data into a comprehensive student profile object.

tasks.name: Risk Level?
tasks.description: Determines risk classification based on profile. Routes to appropriate agent lanes.

tasks.name: Collect Progress Data
tasks.description: Continuously collects student progress metrics (grades, attendance, engagement) during active support cycle.

tasks.name: 2 Weeks
tasks.description: A 2-week interval timer that triggers data collection checkpoints.

tasks.name: End Semester
tasks.description: Decision point: has the semester ended? If yes, triggers Comprehensive Assessment. If not (Continue), loops back.

tasks.name: Comprehensive Assessment
tasks.description: End-of-semester full assessment of student outcomes against initial profile and intervention goals.

swim_lanes.name: COORDINATION_DECISION_AGENT
swim_lanes.role: Central orchestrator. Receives profiles, activates sub-agents, collects responses, synthesizes plans, and makes critical decisions.

tasks.name: Receive Profile
tasks.description: Coordinator receives the generated student profile from the Profiling Agent.

tasks.name: Activate Agents
tasks.description: Coordinator activates all relevant sub-agents: Academic Support, Social Integration, Psychological Wellness.

tasks.name: Collect Responses
tasks.description: Coordinator aggregates plan responses from all activated sub-agents (Academic Plan, Social Plan, Wellness Plan).

tasks.name: Synthesize Final Plan
tasks.description: AI Coordinator synthesizes all sub-agent plans into a single unified, coherent intervention plan for the student.

tasks.name: Interventions Needed?
tasks.description: Decision: does the student require active interventions? Routes to delivery agents if yes.

tasks.name: Analyze Metrics
tasks.description: Coordinator analyzes collected progress metrics to evaluate effectiveness of current support plan.

tasks.name: Critical Adjust?
tasks.description: Decision: is a critical plan adjustment needed based on metrics? Routes to Human Support or continues.

tasks.name: Outcome Report
tasks.description: Generates final outcome report summarizing student progress, interventions delivered, and results.

tasks.name: Next Semester?
tasks.description: Decision: should the student continue into next semester support cycle? If yes, loops back to Registration/new cycle.

outputs.Yes: Back to STUDENT_INTERFACE (View Resources / New Cycle)

swim_lanes.name: ACADEMIC_SUPPORT_AGENT
swim_lanes.role: Assesses academic skills and generates personalized academic intervention plans

tasks.name: Assess Skills
tasks.description: Agent assesses student's current academic skill levels: reading comprehension, writing, numeracy, subject-specific weaknesses.

tasks.name: Generate Academic Plan
tasks.description: Agent generates a personalized academic support plan: tutoring schedule, resource recommendations, study plans, milestones.

swim_lanes.name: SOCIAL_INTEGRATION_AGENT
swim_lanes.role: Assesses social needs and generates social support/mentoring plans

tasks.name: Assess Social Needs
tasks.description: Agent evaluates student's social integration: peer relationships, campus engagement, loneliness, cultural adjustment, group belonging.

tasks.name: Generate Social Plan
tasks.description: Agent creates a social support plan: peer mentoring matching, club/society recommendations, social skills workshops, check-in schedules.

swim_lanes.name: PSYCHOLOGICAL_WELLNESS_AGENT
swim_lanes.role: Conducts psychological screening and generates mental wellness plans

tasks.name: Psych Screening
tasks.description: Agent conducts psychological screening: standardized mental health questionnaires (PHQ-9, GAD-7 etc.), stress assessment, burnout indicators.

tasks.name: Severity?
tasks.description: Classifies psychological severity level.

tasks.name: Generate Wellness Plan
tasks.description: Agent creates a mental wellness support plan: counseling referrals, mindfulness resources, stress management tools, peer support groups.

swim_lanes.name: INTERVENTION_DELIVERY_AGENT
swim_lanes.role: Delivers the actual interventions (academic resources, social mentoring, wellness check) to the student

tasks.name: Deliver: Academic Resources
tasks.description: Delivers curated academic resources to student: readings, videos, tutoring sessions, LMS integrations.

tasks.name: Deliver: Social Mentoring
tasks.description: Connects student with peer mentors, schedules social engagement activities, delivers community resources.

tasks.name: Deliver: Wellness Check
tasks.description: Delivers wellness check-ins, mental health resources, counseling appointment booking, crisis hotline info if needed.

tasks.name: Sync
tasks.description: Synchronization point — waits for all active delivery tasks to complete before proceeding.

tasks.name: Log Delivery
tasks.description: Logs all delivered interventions with timestamps, student acknowledgment, and delivery status into the system.

swim_lanes.name: HUMAN_SUPPORT_SERVICES
swim_lanes.role: Human-in-the-loop override layer for critical cases requiring human judgment

tasks.name: Human Consultation
tasks.description: A human counselor/advisor reviews the case flagged as critical. Makes judgment calls that AI cannot safely handle autonomously.

tasks.name: Update AI Parameters
tasks.description: Human consultant updates AI system parameters: adjusts thresholds, modifies intervention strategies, overrides AI recommendations where needed.
outputs: T_CDA_03 (Collect Responses) — Human support feedback loop

flow_labels.incoming: Critical (from Coordination Agent or Psych Agent)

gateways_summary.name: Risk Level?
gateways_summary.logic: Routes profile to Coordinator with risk classification attached

gateways_summary.name: Severity?
gateways_summary.logic: If screening reveals critical mental health risk, bypasses normal plan generation and escalates immediately

gateways_summary.name: Interventions Needed?
gateways_summary.logic: Can trigger one or multiple delivery streams simultaneously based on synthesized plan

gateways_summary.name: Critical Adjust?
gateways_summary.logic: Based on metric analysis: if performance is critically poor, escalates to human; otherwise flows to end-of-semester review

gateways_summary.name: End Semester
branches: Continue → loop back to Collect Progress Data
gateways_summary.logic: Temporal decision: continues bi-weekly monitoring until semester end is reached

gateways_summary.name: Next Semester?
gateways_summary.logic: Determines if student re-enters system for next academic term

gateways_summary.name: Sync
gateways_summary.logic: Synchronizes parallel delivery tasks before logging completion

happy_path: Assess Skills (Academic) + Assess Social Needs + Psych Screening (parallel)
Generate Academic Plan + Generate Social Plan + Generate Wellness Plan (parallel)
Deliver: Academic Resources + Social Mentoring + Wellness Check (parallel)
critical_escalation_path: Back to Collect Responses / Synthesize Final Plan
monitoring_loop: 2-Week Timer → Collect Progress Data → Analyze Metrics
End Semester? → Continue → Loop back to Collect Progress Data

implementation_notes.agent_technology: Each agent should be implemented as an independent microservice or LLM-powered module with defined input/output schemas.
implementation_notes.coordination_mechanism: The COORDINATION_DECISION_AGENT is the central orchestrator — implement as an LLM with tool-calling or an agentic framework (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen etc.).
implementation_notes.timers: The 2-week timer should be implemented as a scheduled cron job or workflow scheduler (e.g., Temporal, Airflow, or cloud scheduler).
implementation_notes.gateways: Exclusive gateways map to conditional if/else logic. The parallel gateway (Sync) maps to Promise.all() or parallel task execution.
implementation_notes.human_in_the_loop: HUMAN_SUPPORT_SERVICES requires a human dashboard/notification system — build a case management UI for counselors.
implementation_notes.persistence: All data objects should be persisted to a database between steps (student profile, plans, logs) to support async multi-step workflows.
implementation_notes.cycle_management: The semester cycle loop requires stateful process management — use a workflow engine that supports long-running processes.
implementation_notes.critical_path: The CRITICAL escalation path (Psych Agent → Human Services) must be implemented with real-time alerting — not batched.
implementation_notes.feedback_loops: Three distinct feedback loops must be implemented: (1) plan adjustment loop, (2) monitoring loop, (3) human override loop.
